summary: The prepared main checkout already includes upstream PR #32736, which fixes mixed-precision compressed-tensors parsing. The real Qwen3.6 NVFP4 config now retains expert activation metadata and selects the NVFP4 MoE scheme; the historical parser state reproduces the reported NoneType.num_bits exception.

tests.what_was_measured: Five existing CPU regressions covering mixed-precision per-group formats, activation retention, ignore-list boundaries, exact/regex/suffix matching, and weight-only scheme selection; 5 passed.

Against the checkpoint's published config, all three expert projections retain nvfp4-pack-quantized 4-bit tensor_group activations and get_moe_scheme selects CompressedTensorsW4A4Nvfp4MoE; replaying the historical missing-activation input reproduces AttributeError on NoneType.num_bits.

A tensor elementwise calculation ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 and matched an independent CPU reference with maximum absolute error 0.0; this is GPU availability evidence, not NVFP4 validation.

remaining_limitations: The 35B checkpoint weights were not downloaded and a full serving-path reproduction was not performed.
The assigned gfx950 AMD GPU cannot validate the NVIDIA Blackwell-only NVFP4 MoE implementation.
NEXTN speculative decoding, CUDA kernel execution, model semantic accuracy, and the issue's full launch command remain unverified.
